pages.title: Pattern Template
pages.text: A Turing pattern set in gel: stripes and spots at exactly the spacing asked for, as a leopard's are laid down before it is born. Made in the Pattern Basin. With a Turing Morphogen, Bioculture grows Morphogenic Serum cheaply from it; the growing tissues of Biology are laid out by it.
Made in $(item)Pattern Basin$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Reaction and Diffusion.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Morphogenic Serum.
